intro.text: A Hallandren goddess who gave up her divine Breath, and with it her life, three or more years before Siri married the God King.
A goddess of Hallandren who guided Lightsong through his first years as a Returned, and who died by giving her divine Breath to heal a young girl.

items.text: Calmseer Returned with no memory of her earlier life and spent several years in the Court of Gods, hearing petitions and judging art. She also took the newly Returned Lightsong under her wing and helped him settle into his new life.
She shared a meal with Lightsong and Allmother on the eve of the day she gave up her Breath to cure a young girl.

personality.text: Lightsong thinks her the most truly divine of the recent Returned, and Allmother agrees. She cared deeply about her followers and, without giving up her Breath, often found other ways to help them, though she often told Lightsong she felt guilty for never giving her own life to grant a petition.
